summary: Media playback became more reliable when seeking, changing playback speed, rebasing stream clocks, or shutting down the media graph, reducing freezes, audio/video drift, and false underrun reports. AudioConverter gained configurable resampling quality, while VideoFrame conversion now correctly handles rotation, picture regions, and YUV strides. Firefox also improved AudioWorklet message passing and made video picture-in-picture sizing respect Resist Fingerprinting (RFP), which helps limit fingerprinting through window dimensions.
